# Frequently Asked Questions and Tips

## Frequently asked questions

**Can [<u>Projects</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#project) include multiple [<u>methods</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method)?**

- Yes, [<u>Projects</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#project) can include multiple [<u>methods</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method).

**Can [<u>Syntheses</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) include multiple [<u>methods</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method)?**

- No, [<u>Synthesis</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) must only contain one [<u>method</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method). Separate [<u>Syntheses</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses) must be made for different [<u>methods</u>](https://globalarchivemanual.github.io/GlobalArchive/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#method).

**If I am uploading for someone else what information do I need to get from the custodian?**

- [<u>Here</u>](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gtMNcZZqBqG3ylUPD68KqdbANHUKfVJ0XXHdkySHXRk/edit?gid=0#gid=0) is a spreadsheet to get the custodian to fill out
